company_name: Kanagawa Institute of Industrial Science and Technology
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company is involved in research and development for electronic packaging technologies, which are crucial for semiconductor applications.
summary: The Kanagawa Institute of Industrial Science and Technology focuses on advancing electronic packaging technologies through collaborative research initiatives. They facilitate partnerships among various stakeholders, including universities and research institutes, to drive innovation in next-generation packaging systems.
capabilities: Research and development in electronic packaging systems
Collaboration with multiple organizations for joint R&D projects
Technical discussions and lectures on packaging technology
